<script setup lang="ts">
import { CollapsibleRoot as ArkCollapsibleRoot } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import type { CollapsibleRootEmits, CollapsibleRootProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleRootProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

export interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleRootEmits {}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineEmits<Emits>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCollapsibleRoot
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.root, className)"
    data-slot="collapsible-root"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCollapsibleRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CollapsibleRootProvider as ArkCollapsibleRootProvider } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import type { CollapsibleRootProviderProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleRootProviderProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
  value: CollapsibleRootProviderProps['value'];
}

const { class: className, value } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCollapsibleRootProvider
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.root, className)"
    :value="value"
    data-slot="collapsible-root-provider"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCollapsibleRootProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CollapsibleTrigger as ArkCollapsibleTrigger } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import type { CollapsibleTriggerProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleTriggerProps {
  asChild?: CollapsibleTriggerProps['asChild'];
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { asChild = false, class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCollapsibleTrigger
    v-bind="attrs"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="clsx(!asChild && styles.trigger, className)"
    data-slot="collapsible-trigger"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCollapsibleTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CollapsibleIndicator as ArkCollapsibleIndicator } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import type { CollapsibleIndicatorProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { ChevronDownIcon } from '@/lib/moduix/icons/ui/Icons';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleIndicatorProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCollapsibleIndicator
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.indicator, className)"
    data-slot="collapsible-indicator"
  >
    <slot><ChevronDownIcon /></slot>
  </ArkCollapsibleIndicator>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CollapsibleContent as ArkCollapsibleContent } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import type { CollapsibleContentProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/collapsible';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleContentProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkCollapsibleContent
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.content, className)"
    data-slot="collapsible-content"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkCollapsibleContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ark } from '@ark-ui/vue/factory';
import type { HTMLArkProps } from '@ark-ui/vue/factory';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import styles from './Collapsible.module.css';

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

export interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ HTMLArkProps<'div'> {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class'];
}

const { class: className } = defineProps<Props>();
defineSlots<{ default?: () => unknown }>();

const attrs = useAttrs();
</script>

<template>
  <ark.div
    v-bind="attrs"
    :class="clsx(styles.body, className)"
    data-scope="collapsible"
    data-part="body"
    data-slot="collapsible-body"
  >
    <slot />
  </ark.div>
</template>
